action.objective: Verify c2c3 at full depth to close the reserved verification, then compare against f1g2 development.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 2 gives c2c3 an exact 1373, only marginally above f1g2 (1366, exact, develops the bishop). Rows like d1d2 and h1g1 are bound=upper and cannot be trusted as ties. c2c3's PV (c3xd4, Qxd4) risks exposing the queen-side to checks; I need single-candidate verification at full depth to see whether the pawn advance is genuinely better than simply developing f1g2.
